title: .NET Backend Developer Intern
description: Bluesense is a cutting-edge AI company specializing in artificial intelligence, computer vision, and machine learning. We build AI-driven products and provide AI integration and consultancy services, transforming data science and deep learning into practical solutions for real-world problems. Our work connects with innovation ecosystems and product initiatives such as a Smart Beauty App, aligned with communities like Harvard Innovation Labs (Harvard University) and ITU ARI Teknokent / ARI Çekirdek. This is a full-time remote, unpaid compulsory internship role for a .NET Backend Developer at Bluesense. The intern will contribute to real product development by building and improving backend services using C# and ASP.NET Core, focusing on clean architecture, reliable APIs, and scalable system design. You’ll work on: Building and maintaining RESTful APIs for production-style applications Designing and implementing backend services, business logic, and data workflows Working with databases and optimizing data access layers Ensuring system reliability, performance, and security best practices Collaborating with a remote team through task tracking, code reviews, and iterative delivery Develop backend features using C# and ASP.NET Core based on product requirements and system designs Design and implement RESTful APIs (controllers, services, DTOs, request/response models) Work with databases (SQL Server / PostgreSQL) including schema design, queries, and optimization Apply OOP principles and clean architecture practices (layered architecture, separation of concerns, SOLID basics) Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms (JWT, role-based access control basics) Handle error management, logging, and validation to ensure robust and predictable APIs Improve backend quality through: Debugging and fixing issues Refactoring for readability, scalability, and maintainability Basic performance improvements (query optimization, caching awareness) Work in a remote workflow: Use Git (branches, commits, pull requests) Participate in code reviews Communicate progress clearly and deliver tasks incrementally Solid knowledge of C# and .NET / ASP.NET Core Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, SOLID basics) Familiarity with REST API design principles Basic knowledge of databases and SQL Strong problem-solving mindset: able to investigate backend issues and debug systematically Comfortable working independently in a remote environment (time management, clear updates) Developed backend title: Full-Stack & Görüntü İşleme Mühendisi (React -Java -Python)
description: Büyüyen ekibimize, ölçeklenebilir uygulamalar geliştirmeye ve gerçek dünya problemlerini görüntü işleme ile çözmeye tutkuyla yaklaşan yeni bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Hem frontend–backend geliştirme süreçlerinde hem de görüntü işleme ve veri odaklı modellerde çalışmaktan keyif alıyorsanız, bu rol tam size göre. SORUMLULUKLAR Yazılım Geliştirme React.js ile web uygulamaları geliştirmek ve sürdürmek (Vue.js deneyimi artı değer). Java (tercihen Spring Boot) ile backend servisleri ve REST API’leri geliştirmek. Temiz, test edilebilir ve iyi dokümante edilmiş kod yazmak. Agile/Scrum ekipleri ile uyum içinde çalışmak. İlişkisel veya NoSQL veritabanları ile çalışmak. Görüntü İşleme Büyük ölçekli görüntü/video verilerini işlemek, analiz etmek ve yönetmek. Yapılandırılmamış veriler üzerinde görüntü işleme teknikleri uygulamak. Nesne tespiti, takip, segmentasyon gibi alanlarda derin öğrenme modelleri geliştirmek, değerlendirmek ve optimize etmek. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, YOLO, OpenCV, NumPy, PIL vb. kütüphaneleri aktif şekilde kullanmak. Görüntü analizi algoritmaları tasarlamak ve bunu üretim ortamlarına entegre etmek. Kurum içinde öngörüsel karar mekanizmalarını otomatikleştiren modeller geliştirmek. Minimum Gereksinimler Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Elektrik/Elektronik Mühendisliği veya ilgili bir alanda Lisans/Yüksek Lisans derecesi (veya eşdeğer tecrübe). Yazılım geliştirme veya görüntü işleme alanında en az 2–4 yıl deneyim (en az 1+ yıl görüntü işleme deneyimi güçlü bir artıdır). Aşağıdaki konularda güçlü bilgi birikimi: React.js veya benzer frontend framework’leri Java & OOP (Spring Boot bilgisi tercih edilir) Python ve CV/ML kütüphaneleri (OpenCV, NumPy, PyTorch/TensorFlow vb.) Nesne tespiti, takip veya segmentasyon modelleri konusunda deneyim. NVIDIA GPU veya bulut tabanlı eğitim ortamlarında çalışabilme. Git ve versiyon kontrol süreçleri konusunda yetkinlik. Tercih Edilen Nitelikler Docker/Kubernetes ve bulut platformları (AWS, Azure, GCP) bilgisi. ML araştırmalarını üretim ortamına aktarabilme becerisi. Veri yapıları ve algoritmalar konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak. UI/UX prensiplerine ilgi. IoT teknolojilerine aşinalık. İmkanlar Agile Ekip: Dinamik, destekleyici ve çevik bir ekiple çalışma fırsatı. Öğrenme & Gelişim: Mentorluk ve sürekli öğrenme kültürü, Udemy & Coursera erişimi, Eğitim ve konferans desteği, Düzenli Product & Tech Talks Yan Haklar: Yemek kartı, Doğum günü izni, Ekipman desteği, Özel sağlık sigortası Çalışma Esnekliği: Projeye bağlı olarak hibrit veya remote çalışma seçenekleri

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django) based in Turkey. Join a fast-growing, international technology environment where your backend expertise will directly support a global connectivity platform. You will build and scale high-performance APIs and mission-critical microservices used by millions of travelers worldwide. The role combines hands-on backend engineering with software architecture responsibilities, particularly around operations, automation, and scalability. You will help strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and modern development practices. Working closely with Product and QA teams, you will turn complex business requirements into resilient and maintainable solutions. You will also have the opportunity to tackle technical debt and performance challenges in a high-load environment. This is a fully remote role within a collaborative, international team that values continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and autonomy. Accountabilities Build, maintain, and optimize mission-critical microservices using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework (DRF). Design and develop scalable APIs capable of supporting high-concurrency traffic and significant usage peaks. Contribute to software architecture, with a particular focus on operations, automation, resilience, and scalable engineering practices. Establish and maintain strong quality frameworks through comprehensive unit testing with Pytest and automated quality checks. Identify and resolve technical debt, performance bottlenecks, inefficient database queries, N+1 problems, and asynchronous processing issues. Design and implement microservices that integrate effectively with complex third-party systems and services. Improve application performance and reliability through profiling, optimization, and appropriate asynchronous programming techniques. Work closely with Product, QA, and other engineering stakeholders across international teams to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Champion software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including design patterns, technical documentation, code reviews, and maintainability. Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives, helping create efficient and scalable development and operational processes. Act as a technical reference for backend engineering and contribute strategic thinking while remaining hands-on with implementation. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend development experience, with strong expertise in Django and Django REST Framework. Advanced proficiency in Python, with a solid understanding of backend architecture and production software development. Proven experience designing and building microservices architectures and integrating complex third-party applications or ecosystems. Strong experience with unit testing and quality-first development practices, including Pytest or comparable testing frameworks. Practical experience with asynchronous programming and optimizing high-load database queries. Demonstrated ability to identify performance issues and improve application efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Strong understanding of API design, software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable code practices. Experience working with code reviews, technical documentation, automated quality checks, and modern software development processes. Excellent professional English skills (C1 minimum) for effective communication in an international, distributed environment. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to express technical ideas clearly and contribute constructively to team decisions. Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach and a willingness to take ownership of technical challenges. Spanish fluency or professional working proficiency is a plus. Experience with Silk or other application performance profiling tools is an advantage. Benefits 100% remote-first working environment with flexible hours. Opportunity to work on a high-impact global connectivity platform serving millions of users. A technically challenging role with significant influence over architecture, scalability, automation, and engineering quality. International and diverse team with colleagues working remotely across multiple locations. Collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and strong engineering practices. Opportunity to contribute to a rapidly scaling technology business and see the direct impact of your technical decisions. Supportive environment that values teamwork, learning, autonomy, and professional growth. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Her geçen gün büyüyen ve gelişen ekibimizde; öğrenmeye ve gelişime açık, analitik düşünce yapısına sahip ve takım çalışmasına yatkın bir Junior Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. Yeni fikirlerin rahatlıkla paylaşılabildiği ve yeni teknolojileri deneyimleyebileceğin geniş bir gelişim alanına sahip bir çalışma ortamımız var. Web teknolojilerinde kendini geliştirerek fark yaratırken, bir yandan köpek dostlarımızın daha sağlıklı yaşamasına katkı sağlamak istersen başvurunu bekliyoruz. İş Tanımı Şirket bünyesindeki web uygulamalarının ve yazılım projelerinin uçtan uca (Full Stack) tasarımı, geliştirilmesi ve sürdürülebilirliği süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, İş analizinden gelen gereksinimleri derinlemesine analiz ederek ölçeklenebilir, güvenli ve performanslı yazılım çözümleri üretmek, Yazılım mimarisi standartlarına uygun, okunabilir, sürdürülebilir ve temiz kod prensiplerine sadık kalarak geliştirme yapmak, Mevcut süreç ve ürünlerin iyileştirilmesinde proaktif davranarak yenilikçi çözüm önerileri getirmek, Sektör trendlerini ve yeni nesil teknolojileri araştırarak projelerin modernizasyonuna ve ekibin teknik gelişimine katkı sağlamak. Genel Nitelikler Laravel frameworkü ile nesne yönelimli programlama (OOP) ve web uygulamaları geliştirme konusunda deneyimli, İlişkisel veritabanları (SQL) ve anahtar-değer (Key-Value) tabanlı veritabanı yapıları (Redis vb.) konusunda bilgi veya tecrübe sahibi, Temel web teknolojilerine (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) iyi derecede hakim, İş gereksinimlerini doğru analiz ederek etkin çözümler üretebilen; planlı, sistematik ve koordinasyon yeteneği yüksek, Yenilikçi (inovatif) düşünme becerisine sahip, süreç ve ürün geliştirme aşamalarında inisiyatif alarak katma değer yaratabilen, Sürekli öğrenmeye açık, yeni teknolojileri ve sektör trendlerini yakından takip ederek hızla adapte olabilen, Güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip, sorumluluk bilinci yüksek ve takım çalışmasına yatkın. Tercihen Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Bilgisayar Bilimleri veya ilgili bölümlerden lisans derecesine sahip, Git ile versiyon yönetimi süreçlerine ve modern iş akışlarına hakim veya deneyimli, Yazılım mimarilerine, temiz kod (Clean Code) prensiplerine ve en iyi uygulama yöntemlerine (Best Practices) meraklı ve bunları hayata geçirmeye istekli, Modern ön yüz (Frontend) framework’lerinden (React, Vue.js, Svelte, Angular vb.) en az birinde deneyim sahibi, DevOps süreçleri, araçları ve kültürü (CI/CD, Docker vb.) hakkında bilgi sahibi.

title: Full Stack Engineer - EMEA
description: Who We Are Is What We Do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. Why should you be part of our success story? As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. Get Ready To Be a part of a truly cross-functional team; Backend Engineers, Frontend Engineers, Product Teams, Designers and QA’s. Participate in product planning (From discovery all the way to deployment); We want your input at all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle! Collaborate! Our teams work together to develop robust new features, API’s, continuously improve our industry-leading products and find and fix any bugs at DeelSpeed. Ensure our customers receive a white-glove experience with our products! Fully own the development of features on the client, server, service, and database The bits and bytes that you’ll bring to your new team: You will develop high-quality, responsive web applications using TypeScript, Javascript, React, Express. Experience with NestJS, Vite, and Next.js is a plus. You will design and implement server-side APIs, data models, and business logic using mainly Express framework You will create client-side function-based React components, hooks, stories, and tests to interact with your server-side work You will create and optimize database schemas, queries, and interactions with Postgres. You will build reusable and modular components on both the front and back end that promote code reusability, maintainability, and scalability. You will perform thorough testing, debugging, and troubleshooting of applications to ensure high-quality deliverables. You will stay updated with emerging web development trends, frameworks, and best practices, and recommend improvements to enhance development processes.
